Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier Profile: Request for legal/entity info — StellaCorp

Hi Elena / StellaCorp contracts team,

Thanks for the demo earlier — we're moving you into our vendor intake workflow so we can create a supplier record and route future POs/invoices correctly. To complete vendor master setup we need a few items from your side; can you return these by end of week if possible?

Required items (short checklist):
- Legal entity name exactly as registered (including punctuation)
- Tax ID (EIN or VAT) + type (EIN/VAT)
- Registered address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Remittance address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name + email + phone
- Bank details for ACH (if ACH will be used) — if you prefer, send these via the secure upload link below
- Attach: W-9 / W-8 / VAT certificate / Articles of Incorporation (PDF)

Attached: Redwood_Onboarding_Form_v1.pdf — you can either fill that form or reply with the individual items above.

Next steps from our side: once we have the items AP will validate and assign a supplier ID and confirm PO routing. If you have a preferred PO-to-email or ERP mapping, include that and Kimberly (AP) will confirm.

Secure upload (recommended for bank details): https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com/tx/4f9a2c

Appreciate it — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Elena — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifications so AP can complete the vendor record: 

1) Can you confirm your preferred invoice email? (you mentioned billing@stellacorp.com — is that vendor-managed inbox the authoritative address you want Redwood to send PO/EDI acknowledgements and invoice receipts to?)
2) For ACH: please use the secure upload link (bank details should not be sent inline). If you prefer, we can send a one-time DocuSign bank authorization instead.
3) Do you have a US tax withholding status form on record (W-9 is sufficient for now)? The W-9 attached looks good but Kimberly will confirm formatting.

If everything above is correct Kimberly will finish setup and we will issue our first PO (canary PO) to the address and invoice path you confirm.

Hi Elena — Kimberly from AP here. We've validated the W-9 and articles. A supplier ID has been created on Redwood: RWD-09124. Please confirm the following so we can route POs and enable 2-way invoice matching: 

- Confirm invoice submission endpoint: billing@stellacorp.com (yes/no)
- Confirm remittance same as registered address (yes/no)
- Confirm you will upload ACH details to the secure link: https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com/tx/4f9a2c
- Preferred PO acknowledgment: Reply to PO PDFs to billing@stellacorp.com OR send API/EDI acknowledgements to integrations@stellacorp.com

I've attached a PO_Routing_Form.xlsx that we use to capture ERP code/GL mapping if you want Redwood to populate your vendor_code on our PO itself. If we don't receive mapping, POs will contain the supplier ID only and invoices should reference RWD-09124.

Attachments: PO_Routing_Form.xlsx

If we get a confirmation today we will issue a canary PO (PO-2027-0581) tomorrow morning to ensure everything flows to your billing inbox.

Thanks — Kimberly
